detect_univariate_changepoints: run CUSUMDetector on univariate time series data to detect increase or decrease changepoints
detect_multivariate_changepoints: run MultiCUSUMDetector on multivariate time series data to detect changepoints in the multivariate mean
detect_vectorized_changepoints: run VectorizedCUSUMDetector on multiple time series to detect changepoints across all series in a vectorized manner
plot_cusum_changepoints: plot CUSUM detection results with vertical lines at detected changepoints and shaded interest windows
compare_cusum_changepoints: compare two CUSUMChangePoint objects for exact equality or approximate equality using the almost_equal method
